independent_source_proof.binding_analysis: Walrus captures the enclosing function variable, not a generator-local assignment. In the old version its bytes binding is unobserved after any(): every later fields load is inside the TCP loop after fields = row.split() overwrites it with text. Verified assignment-before-use structure, all fields occurrences confined to generator/TCP loop, no return/yield or locals/vars/eval/exec observer. New unix_fields is isolated from TCP fields. Runtime locals names differ intentionally, not Stop semantics.
